name: Dwarf
description: Bold and hardy, dwarves are known as skilled warriors, miners, and workers of stone and metal. Though they stand well under 5 feet tall, dwarves are so broad and compact that they can weigh as much as a human standing nearly two feet taller.

grants.name: Darkvision (60 ft)
grants.description: See in dim light within 60 ft. as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (no color, only shades of gray).

grants.name: Dwarven Resilience
grants.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance to poison damage.

grants.name: Dwarven Combat Training
grants.description: Proficiency with the battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, and warhammer.

grants.name: Tool Proficiency
grants.description: Gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

grants.name: Stonecunning
grants.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you're considered proficient and add double your proficiency bonus.

grants.name: Dwarven Toughness
grants.description: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and increases by 1 again every time you gain a level.

grants.name: Dwarven Armor Training
grants.description: Proficiency with light and medium armor.
